newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar closes firmer, spread weakens.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar closes firmer, spread weakens.

text.p: CSCE world sugar finished a narrowly traded session firmer as prices continued to consolidate after a recent selloff, floor sources said.

Selling in the October/March spread near the close limited gains in the spot month and buoyed the most-active contract to near the day's highs on the close, a dealer said. Trade buying gave the March contract an additional boost.
The October/March spread closed at 0.05 compared with 0.10 on Wednesday's close. At least one dealer said the spread could weaken further Friday and even trade at a discount.
The March contract managed to pierce nearby resistance at 11.35 and close slightly above the key price, a sign prices could continue to make gains Friday, analysts said.
The contract settled up 0.07 at 11.37, having ranged from 11.38 to 11.31. Spot-October finished 0.02 firmer at 11.42, while the deferred contracts ended 0.06 to 0.04 firmer.
Open interest in October stood at 31,780 lots, off 3,473 lots. Open interest in March rose 406 lots to 64,909 lots.
LIFFE white sugar futures settled firmer on continued short-covering. Spot December closed up $3.20 at the high of $331.50.
